title: gomphocentrum multiflorum
intro: Gomphocentrum multiflorum, commonly known as the 'Yellow Mandevilla', is a flowering plant species native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating various health conditions such as anxiety, insomnia, and inflammation. The health benefits of Gomphocentrum multiflorum include its anxiolytic, sedative, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in alleviating stress and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often used in traditional medicine to treat a range of health issues.
